resolution: 'Personal' has two uses here. As Marks it is four structural conditions on a frame; as PersonalStop it is a supplied flag. The acting model has the marks whatever flag is supplied, so the marks do not settle the flag, and nothing certifies that any model is or is not a person. Reading a model as a person's choice or as an indeterministic setup is the analyst's reading of one frame, and no step depends on it.
